limitations: Plies are plates clipped to the build cube (square corners retained).
Helical plies are centred at (i+1/2)t (no half-ply overlap), a deviation from the upstream centre at i*t.
Kernel tessellation is used for display/STL of B-Rep designs; its tolerance is set by the kernel defaults.
SDF surface resolution is limited to h = 0.2083 mm (constraints.resolution = 96); features below ~2h are not resolved.
Genus is the first Betti number of the voxel solid (independent handles); it depends on the grid resolution.
Connectivity counts components of at least 27 grid nodes; smaller slivers are reported in observations and not repaired.

min_wall_thickness = 5th percentile of inward-ray chords (absolute minimum reported separately); entry/exit error about ±h/2 = ±0.104 mm; 0 sub-voxel chords discarded. Not a certified manufacturing check.
Repair is capped at 5 rounds and runs one parameter change per round (greedy, no search).
Repairs act on the SDF/B-Rep parameters; they do not change the code structure (priority 3 is not automated).
